placements.title: Authority to command what knowledge may be retained
placements.frame: When does a directive to forget or remove knowledge assert authority over what the organization may hold?
placements.why: Both segments are imperative directives commanding erasure of specific knowledge domains — src-1 targeting the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts, src-2 targeting all zeppelin routes. They share a thematic pattern of asserting authority over knowledge retention through binding commands to forget and remove, a subject future envelopes could continue feeding as further erasure or knowledge-governance directives accumulate.
